description: This Java class 'RetrieveThingsLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl' serves as a builder for constructing responses to a 'RetrieveThingsLiveCommand'. It provides methods to generate 'RetrieveThingsResponse' objects based on a list of 'Thing' instances, applied predicates, and selected fields, encapsulating response creation logic for a specific command in the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: RetrieveThingsLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl
